items.title: Walt Disney (DIS) Cuts 300 Jobs In HR And Tech In Third 2026 Layoff Round
items.summary: Walt Disney (NYSE:DIS) is cutting about 300 roles in its human resources and technology units as part of new layoffs. The reductions, announced in the context of a leadership transition, mark the third round of staff cuts at Disney in 2026. Management is tying the job cuts to a wider effort to trim expenses and rework internal functions for future capacity.
